name: Morgan the Collector
summary: At the Brackwell Pumpkin Patch, Morgan the Collector directs Defias extortion and gathers stolen goods across Elwynn Forest. From the farmhouse, he coordinates the theft while Goldshire's guard watches nearby.

sections.title: The Tithe of Elwynn
sections.body: Morgan the Collector takes gold from Elwynn Forest's mines for the Defias Brotherhood. Common bandits harass travelers on the roads, but Morgan directs organized shakedowns. He gathers stolen coin and supplies for the Brotherhood's wider network. His headquarters is the farmhouse at the Brackwell Pumpkin Patch, where loyal enforcers including Surena Caledon and Erlan Drudgemoor surround him.

sections.title: A Signet of the Past
sections.body: Morgan carries a distinctive signet ring that marks his authority. In Goldshire, investigators see the ring as evidence linking the masked thieves terrorizing the heartland to the disgraced Stonemasons Guild. That guild rebuilt Stormwind City after the Second War. Recovering the ring reveals who directs the bandits in the woods.

faq.answer: Morgan is a high-ranking officer in the Defias Brotherhood. He collects gold taken from Elwynn Forest's mines and coordinates bandit activity in the region.
Morgan keeps his stolen goods in the farmhouse at the Brackwell Pumpkin Patch in eastern Elwynn Forest.
Marshal Dughan and local authorities want Morgan eliminated to sever Defias leadership in Elwynn and recover proof of who organizes the rural uprisings.

faq.q: What is special about the ring he carries?
faq.answer: Morgan carries a signet ring that gives authorities evidence as they investigate his activities in Elwynn Forest.

angles.text: As a Rogue, you can see how Morgan's discipline turns scattered thieves into an organized underground syndicate that funds an insurgency.
As a Human, taking down Morgan strikes back at the traitors who have turned Stormwind's peaceful farms into fortified bandit dens.
